hero.tagline2: From National Service to Social Service
hero.subtitle: Unity, respect, service and continuous commitment to nation-building of Nepal's ex-army soldiers.
hero.aboutTitle: A common platform for ex-army soldiers
hero.aboutP1: Nepal National Ex-Army Association is a voluntary social organization of retired Nepali soldiers. After long military service, this organization has built a united ex-army soldier family with continuous responsibility towards the nation and society.
hero.aboutP2: The organization has been active in areas like welfare, health assistance, skill development, disaster response, blood donation campaigns, and community development. Our priority is to make the lives of retired soldiers and their families dignified and to strengthen the nation's social fabric.
